description: This file defines the 'UspsServices' class providing various USPS API integrations for address validation, rate inquiry, tracking, and service standards within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for domestic and international shipping, rate calculations, address verification, city/state lookup, and shipment updates, utilizing XML-based USPS API requests/responses.

classes.name: UspsServices
classes.description: Main class providing USPS API service methods for address validation, rate inquiry, tracking, and service standards.

methods.name: uspsRateInquire
methods.description: Performs USPS domestic rate inquiry based on shipment details and package info, returning estimated shipping cost.

methods.name: uspsInternationalRateInquire
methods.description: Performs international USPS rate inquiry based on destination country and package info, returning estimated postage.

methods.name: uspsTrackConfirm
methods.description: Tracks a shipment with USPS using tracking ID, returning status summary and details.

methods.name: uspsAddressValidation
methods.description: Validates and standardizes an address via USPS API, returning corrected address info.

methods.name: uspsCityStateLookup
methods.description: Looks up city and state by ZIP code using USPS API.

methods.name: uspsPriorityMailStandard
methods.description: Retrieves USPS priority mail service standard info.

methods.name: uspsPackageServicesStandard
methods.description: Retrieves USPS package service standard info.

methods.name: uspsServiceStandards
methods.description: Helper method to fetch USPS service standards for specified service types.

methods.name: uspsDomesticRate
methods.description: Calculates USPS domestic rate for a given package and shipment details.

methods.name: uspsUpdateShipmentRateInfo
methods.description: Updates shipment route segment with USPS rate info based on origin, destination, and package weights.

methods.name: uspsDeliveryConfirmation
methods.description: Requests USPS delivery confirmation, returning confirmation number and label data.
